`docs/ledger_schema.md`.

sub_intents.description:
Add `.github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml`.
- Triggered on push to main, a daily schedule and `workflow_dispatch`, with a concurrency group.
- It is a green no-op that logs why when the `HOLON_LEDGER_BOT_TOKEN` secret is absent, skips its own promotion
commit, fails if any changed path is outside `holon-knowledge/ledger/`, and retries a push race after a fetch and
rebase.
- Describe it and the maintainer-provided secret in `.github/workflows/README.md`.
- Tests: a parsed-YAML test asserting these properties.
